resources.string: Enter an invitation, IP address, or hostname.
Check the full invitation or enter a valid address. A port must be between 1 and 65535.
Copy the invitation from PiuLink Host on your computer. On the same network, you can also enter its address.
Copy a direct invitation from PiuLink Host and paste it here. If you use Tailscale, connect both devices to your private network and enter the computer’s address.
Enter the invitation or computer address. Select the computer when it appears. If a PIN is shown, enter it on the Host to pair.
Clear all PiuLink logs on this device? This cannot be undone.
Enter a hostname or IP address.
Unable to read this share. Select the file again.
Check the Downloads folder on your computer before continuing. The computer may have saved files before sending a receipt.
Choose the computer to continue sending.
The share contains no files or text to send.
Pair a computer, then return here to send your files.
On the same network, open PiuLink Host on your computer to discover it. To connect from elsewhere, paste its invitation.
